item.title: Q2 Billings Area Weather: Continued mild on Sunday, but changes arrive next week
item.description: Saturday was another extraordinarily mild day for early February in Montana and Wyoming with highs in the 50s and 60s with gusty wind. Sunday will be almost as mild, but we'll cool starting next week.

item.title: Dozens learn life-saving skills at Billings community CPR training
item.description: Dozens of Billings residents are better prepared to save a life after taking part in a free community CPR training class Saturday at Rocky Vista University.

item.title: Residents, caregivers raise concerns over pest infestations at Billings apartment complex
item.description: A Billings nurse says ongoing bed bug and cockroach infestations at a downtown low-income apartment complex have reached a point where some caregivers are refusing to enter the building.
